map.本工具依据临床护理规范与公开应急流程整理，供快速查阅参考，具体处置以医嘱与床旁判: Compiled from clinical nursing standards and public emergency flows for quick reference; actual care follows orders and bedside judgment.
map.跌倒/坠床应急处理核心原则：: Core principles of fall emergency response:
map.1. 立即评估，切勿急于扶起患者: 1. Assess at once; do not rush to lift the patient
map.3. 疑有骨折/脊柱损伤者勿随意搬动: 3. Do not move suspected fracture/spinal injury
map.4. 及时报告医生并记录: 4. Report to the doctor and document promptly
map.发现患者倒地先评估意识与呼吸，禁止盲目扶起疑似骨折者。: On finding a fallen patient, assess consciousness and breathing first; never blindly lift a suspected fracture.
map.疑有脊柱或髋部损伤者原位制动、呼叫医师与放射检查。: Suspected spine or hip injury: immobilize in place, call the physician and imaging.
map.事件 24 小时内上报不良事件系统并填写根因分析。: Report the event to the adverse-event system within 24 h and complete root-cause analysis.
map.输入场景=卫生间跌倒、意识清，工具给出制动—查伤情—通知医师—上报流程，与应急手: Input scene=bathroom fall, conscious; tool gives immobilize-assess-notify-report, matching the emergency manual.
map.本工具能替代现场抢救吗？: Can this tool replace on-site rescue?
map.不能，仅作流程提示，现场以医师判断与急救原则为准。: No; it only cues the flow. On-site follows the physician and first-aid principles.
map.患者要起身怎么办？: What if the patient wants to get up?
map.先安抚评估，无明显损伤征得医师同意后在旁协助缓慢起身。: Reassure and assess first; with no obvious injury and physician approval, assist a slow rise.
map.跌倒属不良事件，上报用于改进环境与流程、降低再发风险。: Falls are adverse events; reporting improves environment and process and lowers recurrence.
